summary: Brookfield Asset Management filed an 8-K under Items 8.01/9.01 furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release dated November 6, 2026. Results show $25 billion raised in Q3 and $123 billion year-to-date, fee-related earnings of $864 million (up 15% year-over-year, $0.54 per share) and distributable earnings of $763 million (up 15%). Fee-bearing capital rose 13% to $682 billion; infrastructure strategies drew roughly $50 billion of commitments over the past year. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed—an ordinary earnings release with no special-situations element.
